register.labelZh: PLAY 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: play along 表示某人假裝同意;play around 和 play at doing something 則表示某人的行為並不認真。；play around with something 適合用來談論在作決定前嘗試不同顏色、版面、設定、構思或其他選擇。；play off、play on、play out 和 play something back 可用來談論決勝賽、繼續作賽、現場演出,以及重新播放聲音或影像。；play A off against B、play on something、play something down 和 play something up 可描述挑動競爭、利用感受、淡化事情或刻意強調某事。；play up 可描述機器或身體部位出問題;play up to 可描述討好他人或按照某種形象表現;play out則可說明事情如何發展。
register.summaryEn: Play along shows that someone pretends to agree, while play around and play at doing something show that a person is not behaving seriously. Play around with something is useful when testing colours, layouts, settings, ideas or other choices before making a decision. Play off, play on, play out and play something back help you discuss deciding matches, continuing games, live performances and recorded sound or video. Play A off against B, play on something, play something down and play something up describe how people create competition, use feelings, reduce importance or give extra attention to something. Play up can describe a machine or body part causing trouble. Play up to can describe flattery or behaviour that matches an image. Play out can show how a situation develops.
